title: Creek Kids Club Extended Day Program: Proration of the Month in Which Billing Ends
content:
**Clause.** When a Creek Kids Club Extended Day Program enrollment is withdrawn, a billing month in which the billing end falls is credited by the proration convention below as a notice-period adjustment. It is billed in full only where that convention credits nothing. The convention follows the student's district enrollment record in Student Enrollment, Transfers and Pre-Kindergarten Admissions for the enrollment's school year, and the Creek Kids Club enrollment's own record. Shares are taken of the credit base.

| Case | How the month is credited |
|---|---|
| The district enrollment record for the school year shows status withdrawn, with a withdrawal date on or before the requested last day. | **By the day:** one 30th of the credit base for each day of the billing month after the district withdrawal date, the month counted as 30 days. |
| That record shows no district withdrawal on or before the requested last day, and the enrollment was withdrawn on the family's written notice. That is, the Creek Kids Club enrollment shows status withdrawn, with no suspension date recorded and a withdrawal notice on file. | **By the whole week:** 25 percent of the credit base for each whole week of seven days between the billing end and day 28 of the billing month. The whole credit base (100 percent) is credited when the billing end falls before the first day of the billing month. |
| Every other case, a student with no district enrollment record for the school year included. | The whole credit base only when the billing end falls before the first day of the billing month, and nothing otherwise. |

## By the day (district withdrawal)

| District withdrawal date | Days of the month after it, month counted as 30 | Share credited |
|---|---|---|
| the 10th | 20 | 20 thirtieths |
| the 29th | 1 | one thirtieth |
| the 30th or 31st | 0 | nothing |
| a date before the billing month | all 30 | the whole credit base |

## By the whole week (family notice)

| Billing end | Whole weeks between it and day 28 | Share credited |
|---|---|---|
| the 7th | 3 | 75 percent |
| the 8th | 2 | 50 percent |
| the 14th | 2 | 50 percent |
| the 15th | 1 | 25 percent |
| the 21st | 1 | 25 percent |
| the 22nd or later | 0 | nothing; the month is billed in full |
| before the first day of the billing month | not applicable | 100 percent |
